metas.name: Hoop Dreams
metas.description:
The American dream appears here as a system that uses kids up. Two Chicago teenagers filmed over five years chasing basketball as a way out, as school, family, money and injury keep intervening.

A film following the lives of two inner-city Chicago boys who struggle to become college basketball players on the road to going professional.

metas.name: Senna
metas.description:
Speed, faith and charisma — entirely from archive. Ayrton Senna's career built only from period footage and voices — rivalry with Prost, Brazil on his helmet, in-car laps that feel like prayer at 300 km/h.

A documentary on Brazilian Formula One racing driver Ayrton Senna, who won the F1 world championship three times before his death at age 34.

metas.name: Free Solo
metas.description:
Alex Honnold's relationship to fear is simply different from yours. He prepares to climb El Capitan without ropes while the filmmakers — his friends — argue on camera about whether filming changes the odds.

Alex Honnold faces the biggest challenge of his career, climbing El Capitan in Yosemite National Park. He pursues it Free Solo, which means climbing without a rope and alone.

metas.name: When We Were Kings
metas.description:
Ali appears here as a political and verbal artist at his peak. The Rumble in the Jungle, Zaire 1974: training footage, a music festival, Mobutu's stadium, and Ali talking everyone, including himself, into belief.

Boxing documentary on the 1974 world heavyweight championship bout between defending champion, George Foreman, and the underdog challenger, Muhammad Ali.

metas.name: The Wrestler
metas.description:
His body only has value inside the ring. An ageing, hearing-damaged wrestler on supermarket shifts, trying with his daughter, and finding the crowd is the one place the world still makes sense to him.

A faded professional wrestler must retire, but finds his quest for a new life outside the ring a dispiriting struggle.

metas.name: Raging Bull
metas.description:
Self-destruction plays out in a family kitchen as much as in a ring. Jake LaMotta's jealousy and violence at home filmed with the same intensity as the fights; he can take any punch except accountability.

The life of boxer Jake LaMotta, whose violence and temper that led him to the top in the ring destroyed his life outside of it.

metas.name: Minding the Gap
metas.description:
The moment comes when a documentarian has to point the camera at himself. Bing Liu films his skateboarder friends in their rust-belt hometown over years, then slowly realises the film is about the violence they all grew up in — including his own.

Filmmaker Bing Liu searches for correlations between his skateboarder friends' turbulent upbringings and the complexities of modern masculinity.

metas.name: Icarus
metas.description:
A documentary gets swallowed by its own story: Fogel films himself doping to expose how easy cheating is, but his Russian scientist accomplice sits at the centre of a state doping programme, and the film becomes his escape plan.

When Bryan sets out to uncover the truth about doping in sports, a chance meeting with a Russian scientist transforms his story from a personal experiment into a geopolitical thriller.

metas.name: AlphaGo
metas.description:
This film sits at the exact historical moment a machine did something its makers couldn't explain. DeepMind's system against Lee Sedol in Seoul, filmed in both camps; Move 37 lands and the human experts go quiet.

Google's DeepMind has developed a program for playing the 3000 year old game Go using AI. They test AlphaGo on the European champion, then March 9-15, 2016, on the top player, Lee Sedol, in a best of 5 tournament in Seoul.

metas.name: Diego Maradona
metas.description:
Kapadia builds fame as a hostage situation where the hostage keeps scoring goals. Maradona's Naples years, assembled entirely from archive: adored as a god, pulled into the Camorra's orbit, collapsing under a worship no person could survive.

Constructed from over 500 hours of never-before-seen footage, this documentary centers on the career of celebrated football player Diego Maradona, who played for S.S.C. Napoli in the 1980s.

metas.name: Moneyball
metas.description:
Competence itself becomes the drama: a general manager and a Yale economist re-derive baseball from its statistics while the entire sport's intuition laughs at them. Observed numbers versus inherited scouting folklore, and the numbers are the love story.

Oakland A's general manager Billy Beane's successful attempt to assemble a baseball team on a lean budget by employing computer-generated analysis to acquire new players.

metas.name: Infinite Football
metas.description:
One man has spent thirty years redesigning football. After an injury ended his career, Laurențiu Ginghină concluded the rules themselves were at fault — too much running, too many collisions — and has been revising them ever since, explaining octagonal pitches to indulgent officials. A deadpan documentary about systems-thinking as a life's consolation: the local instance of a universal type.

They talk about the beautiful game, but for Laurentiu Ginghina, it's not enough. Football must be modified, streamlined, freed from restraints; corners are to be rounded off, players assigned to zones and subteams, norms revised. ...

metas.name: Children of Heaven
metas.description:
Two siblings run a logistics operation beyond most adults. A boy loses his sister's shoes — the family's only pair for her — and the two construct an elaborate daily timeshare of his own shoes, sprinting between schools, telling no one. The third act is a footrace he must finish exactly third: the prize is a pair of shoes. Stakes this small, engineered this precisely, become unbearable.

After a boy loses his sister's pair of shoes, he goes on a series of adventures in order to find them. When he can't, he tries a new way to "win" a new pair.
